messages:
jen: Quick sync — timeline reset meeting in 30m. We need to agree an anchor for MVP vs v1 cuts so teams can replan. Can folks bring customer-impact priorities and a single rollback lane?
omar: I put together a short impact matrix in the doc: https://redwood.app/notes/anchor-matrix — highlights: Embeddings cache -> high infra cost, medium customer impact; Multi-tenant SSO -> high customer impact, risky infra.
katie: Agree on SSO being high impact. Suggest we keep SSO for MVP only for pilot customers, flag full GA to v1. Also want telemetry gating in MVP to detect regressions early.
mike: From infra: if we keep embeddings cache in MVP we need a 2w buffer for Dedicated capacity and a fallback quantized model. Otherwise suggest moving it to v1.
jen: Proposed anchor (for the 3/14 ship):
- MVP: core text generation, basic SSO pilot (tenant opt-in), telemetry + minimal evals
- Defer to v1: embeddings cache, advanced tenant routing, multi-region DR
Can we agree on that as a starting point?
omar: I like it. Customer ask log: Acme and Boxly prioritized SSO pilot above caches.
katie: Telemetry: need a clear pass/fail signal — propose `>=95% token quality on the smoke prompt set` and no 10s+ tail latency regressions on 99th pct.
jen: Noted. Add to rollout checklist: quality guardrail + fallback model + canary route.
mike: I'll add infra dependencies and mark two blockers: Dedicated pool quota and model-quantization test. ETA for blockers: 48h if we expedite.
release-bot: Reminder — schedule pinned: release window 2025-03-14 16:00 UTC. Canary starts 2025-03-13 22:00 UTC.
jen: Ok — action items: 1) Omar: prioritize customer list and update impact doc (by EOD) 2) Mike: confirm Dedicated capacity ETA (48h) 3) Katie: draft telemetry pass/fail and smoke prompts (tomorrow AM) 4) Eng leads: prepare rollback plan (canary + fallback model)
omar: on it. Will surface any escalations. :thumbsup:
katie: Will post telemetry PR and sample prompts in #eng tomorrow.
mike: Locking a tentative infra slot; will confirm within 24h.
jen: Thanks. If anything changes ping me. We'll finalize anchor in the meeting.
